profile.headline: SWE @ Pinterest
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Hi there! I am a SWE at Pinterest with a keen interest in full-stack development and human-computer interaction. My passion for diversity and inclusion in the tech industry fuels my drive to continuously learn and grow. Let's connect and explore ways to make an impact!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Ads Create: Audiences, Targeting, Modules team

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Pull zip code data by IP address to populate the company database of website visitor information and implement vanity redirects to support physical mailing marketing campaigns using TypeScript, Lua and nginx config files
- Move static marketing/search engine optimization files and route website traffic to Google Cloud Storage in order to accelerate and streamline development speed with CircleCI automation, Docker and nginx
- Collaborate with a horizontal, cross-platform team including engineers, product managers and stakeholders by updating status tickets in Jira, contributing to project-based technical design documents and conducting Security Design Reviews
- Deploy microservices to production-ready website, write unit tests and create logging/alerting with Splunk

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
- Assist 90+ students in the Computer Science Slack workspace, answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems
- Hold office hours for students in the class “Introduction to Computer Science”
- Compile computer science studying resources and contribute to professors’ course website

positions.title: Service Desk Technician
positions.description:
- Accommodated issue tickets and brought the problems to efficient, productive resolution
- Assisted with a range of first-tier support issues, from basic troubleshooting of personal devices to printers to password resets
- Provided front-line support for classroom and video conferencing events

positions.title: Linux DevOps Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and built a website for the computer lab at Bennington College for easy SSH access
- Created an issue submission page, a hostmap of 22 IP computer lab addresses and a schedule-calendar page
- Deployed website with Flask, Docker, Gunicorn and nginx
